areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Integrated territorial planning, urban drainage and housing components directly related, with relevant resources; SMART indicators, moderate impact given city scale.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Secondary alignment via nature-based solutions and revegetation, but indicator shows these are not applied across all intervention areas; lower relevance.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Objectives and components directly aligned with risk reduction and adaptation; significant resources, SMART indicators with viable targets, high impact on vulnerable households.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening is a specific objective, with a monitoring module product; chosen indicator not relevant enough, so impact judged of lower relevance.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Drainage works do not address water availability or efficient use; no related products or indicators.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Municipal-scale programme addresses intra-urban disparities, not macro-regional inequality.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Upgrading a monitoring module is not a strategic digital transformation agenda; no suitable indicators.
